name: wget Download Test
description: Downloads a resource via wget to measure HTTP/HTTPS download performance. Parameter 'url': the URL to fetch. Parameter 'output_file': destination path (use /dev/null to discard). Parameter 'timeout_seconds': per-connection timeout. Parameter 'tries': number of retry attempts.
specification: Fetch the resource at 'url' using wget, writing the response body to 'output_file' with a per-connection timeout of 'timeout_seconds' and at most 'tries' retries.

workflow.specification: Fetch the resource at 'url' using wget, writing the response body to 'output_file' with a per-connection timeout of 'timeout_seconds' and at most 'tries' retries.
